描述_ZN: Banana Shade Cooking Tea" album page, modern, painted by Fu Baoshi, on paper, color on paper, 32 cm in length and 37.2 cm in width.　　The painting is self-titled: "Made by Baishi in the eighth month of the year yiyou." Inscriptions: "Fu" in vermilion and "Often drunk" in vermilion.　　Biyou is the year 1945.　　As a specialty of China, tea is an indispensable beverage in the daily life of the people. The proverb "open the door to seven things - rice, oil, salt, soy sauce, vinegar and tea", thus showing its importance. With the passage of time, the literati and scholars gradually cooked tea as a leisure time elegant thing, to cleanse the temperament, cultivate sentiment. Many painters in successive generations have drawn this subject matter, showing one end of the literati's light and leisurely life.　　This picture depicts a scene in Jiangnan, with several banana trees and broad leaves shading the sun. Under the shade, the scholar is sitting in front of the tea stove with a fan in his hand, waiting for his servant to bring water. The character is portrayed with attention to his inner world, and his concentration is vivid and subtle. The broad leaves are all colored with color, and the veins of the leaves are sketched with the center stroke, which is natural. The coloring is light and cool, and the greenery is lush and elegant, and the atmosphere of leisure and tranquility is straightforward. The whole picture style tone unity, rich expression of the characters, trees and rocks vibrant, brushwork such as flowing, outstanding.　　This picture was donated by Fu Baoshi's wife Luo Shihui.
